run_policy.protocol: Wrap each query as a trigger-selection task: choose matching repository Skills from name and description, open each selected SKILL.md so loading is observable, report the selected names, and do not solve the underlying task.
run_policy.repetition_rule: Run each retained case once under the candidate condition, then repeat only when variation, an unexpected result, model differences, or failure impact makes another observation decision-relevant.
run_policy.verdict_rule: Record pass, fail, unstable, not exposed, or not executed for every observed condition. Mixed observed results are unstable, not a pass.
